# Dashandots Technology

> Dashandots Technology is a custom software development company based in Gurugram, India. We build enterprise-grade ERP, CRM, TMS, HMS, e-commerce and custom web/mobile applications for SMEs and growing businesses in India and internationally.

We deliver end-to-end software — from requirements and UX design through development, deployment and post-launch support. Our stack spans PHP/Laravel, Node.js, React, Flutter, MySQL/PostgreSQL, and embedded firmware (ESP32, STM32, FreeRTOS). Products are built for the Indian market with GST compliance, payment gateway integration and ERP sync out of the box.

Target clients: small and medium enterprises, logistics and transport operators, hospitals and clinics, retail chains and manufacturers seeking affordable, robust alternatives to expensive off-the-shelf software.

- [Portfolio & Live Demos](https://dashandots.com/portfolio): Client work and hosted product demos

## Services

- [Custom ERP Development](https://dashandots.com/services/erp-development/): Inventory, procurement, production planning, finance & accounting, HR & payroll, reporting dashboards; GST-compliant for Indian SMEs
- [Web & Mobile Applications](https://dashandots.com/services/web-mobile-apps/): Full-stack web apps (React, Node.js, PHP, Laravel) and Flutter mobile apps for iOS and Android; portals, dashboards, SaaS platforms
- [E-commerce & Portals](https://dashandots.com/services/ecommerce/): B2B/B2C stores, dealer portals, multi-vendor marketplaces with GST invoicing and payment gateway integration
- [Industry Systems (TMS, HMS, CRM)](https://dashandots.com/services/industry-systems/): Transport management, hospital management and customer relationship management systems
- [Data Analytics & AI](https://dashandots.com/services/data-analytics/): BI dashboards, ETL pipelines, ML forecasting, LLM workflow integrations
- [IoT & Embedded Software](https://dashandots.com/services/iot-embedded/): Firmware (ESP32, STM32), MQTT/LoRaWAN device-cloud pipelines, OTA updates, FreeRTOS systems

## Live Product Demos

- [Transport Management System demo](https://tms.dashandots.com/login): Fleet tracking, route optimisation, driver management, freight billing, trip sheets
- [Hospital Management System demo](https://hms.dashandots.com/login): Patient registration, appointments, EMR/EHR, billing, pharmacy, laboratory, inventory
